name: Do I need to repaint my entire house after storm damage, or can I do touch-ups?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to repaint my entire house after storm damage, or can I do touch-ups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you need a full repaint or can opt for touch-ups depends on the extent and nature of the storm damage. If the damage is localized, such as a few chipped spots or minor water stains, touch-ups might suffice. However, if there's widespread peeling, significant substrate damage, or extensive fading on multiple surfaces, a full repaint often provides a more uniform, durable, and aesthetically pleasing result. A professional assessment can help determine the most cost-effective and long-lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: It depends on the damage. Localized issues may allow touch-ups, but widespread damage often requires a full repaint for best results.
